suggestions.text: Resolved research-intelligence-dashboard:s78
Declined research-intelligence-dashboard:s79
Declined research-intelligence-dashboard:s80
Declined supplement-pdf-reports:s39
Once DatabaseSeeder calls DemoUserSeeder, add a test that db:seed leaves one demo user who can log in
Add an IP-only login throttle alongside the per-email+IP one, against credential stuffing across many emails
Add a My genetics nav link in the header when genetics.profile exists
Add max:255 to the login email rule; the throttle key embeds the raw email
Remember-me checkbox was not in spec and is untested: drop it or add a test
Test the post-login redirect to genetics.profile once that route exists
Refuse to seed the demo user in production when DEMO_USER_PASSWORD is unset or the default
Configure trustProxies before deploying behind a proxy so the login throttle keys on the real client IP
Assert session regeneration at HTTP level rather than inside Livewire::test
Let FakeWebResearcher queue a different result or failure per call so multi-search tests need no inline researcher
Put a re-run action next to the 'Re-run research to check genetic interactions' hint
Delete/create gene interactions through the supplement relation for consistency with other child rows
Normalise URLs (trailing slash, fragment) when de-duplicating merged sources
Cover a gene search that returns an empty list
Cap the number of gene_interactions accepted per run (e.g. 30) with a test
Guard the gene_query sprintf against a misconfigured format (catch ValueError, skip the gene search) or document the single %s
Re-run the Recommendations boundary probes once that module exists; they are vacuous until then
Document the reference_allele (non-risk plus-strand allele) / risk_allele convention and the FUT2 direction caveat
Cap AddVariant's source label at 255 chars (upload file names)
copiesOf: return 0 for an empty or multi-character allele instead of throwing
Retry once on UniqueConstraintViolationException when concurrent adds race on rsid/user
toPlusStrand: skip the complement flip when only one reference allele is known to avoid false matches
Flaky encryption test: not->toContain('CT') on ciphertext; assert Crypt decrypts to plaintext instead
Test that a guest bounced from /genetics lands back on /genetics after login (intended URL)
User-typed gene label lands on the shared reference row; treat it as a lookup hint only (lookup result overwrites it) and consider a daily cap on new reference rows per user
Add a guest addVariant case with valid input asserting nothing is written
Make isLookedUp() protected (public methods are client-callable actions) and replace the \u{10FFFF} null-gene sort sentinel with an explicit comparator
Real-browser check of a 25 MB upload once Herd upload limits are raised
Re-check Livewire temp-upload metadata cleanup (FileUploadConfiguration internals) after each Livewire upgrade
genetics:reap-stale should also delete raw files left on uploads stuck in Queued/Parsing
Set Livewire temporary upload middleware to auth + a per-user throttle instead of the default 60/min per IP
Scheduled prune of genetics livewire-tmp files older than 1h and of uploads stuck active with their files
Exercise the real genetics temp disk and .json sidecar deletion instead of Livewire's tmp-for-tests disk
Bound fgets line length (e.g. 8192) and skip or fail on over-long lines
Use RateLimiter::attempt for atomic check-and-hit on upload/add limits
original_name / user_variants.source may contain a person's name: document as personal data or encrypt
Document that the last attempt marks Failed and swallows (no failed_jobs row); count found_count after rsid de-dup
Pass a default to config('genetics.max_marker_rows') so a missing key doesn't reject every marker list
Show the stored lookup error (add error to VariantData) and a per-row loading state on Look up
Daily spend ceiling on lookups per user
Render test that genetics::prompts.lookup escapes source markdown
Revert the LookingUp claim if dispatch throws; the reaper covers lost jobs later
On upload-job retry, subtract lookups already claimed by this upload from the cap
Global/daily lookup budget (e.g. RateLimiter key genetics-lookup-global); per-user bounds still allow ~100 paid lookups/min
Fall back to default lookup domains (or fail closed) when GENETICS_LOOKUP_DOMAINS is empty; an empty list allows any host
Use @js($variant->rsid) in wire:click lookUp instead of string interpolation
Real-render check against a multi-page lab-style PDF with embedded fonts (synthetic data)
Page/size guard before pdfparser loads a large PDF into memory
Cache the reference gene list used for line filtering
Drop a line that doesn't fit whole under max_chars instead of truncating mid-token
Keep only extracted rsIDs that appear in the lines sent to the model (blocks invented/injected rows); add a test
Size/page pre-check for PDFs and a worker memory guard; pdfparser is unbounded on crafted files
Scrub invalid UTF-8 before the /u regexes; optionally strip non-marker tokens (names) from sent lines
Consolidate per-module arch tests under tests/Arch; each costs ~8MB in the full run (memory limit raised to 512M meanwhile)
End-to-end /supplements/{id} test of the Your genetics panel
Full-page GET of /supplements/{id} as guest and as user B asserting no genotype in HTML
Fail closed: branch on a null relevance result instead of @auth
If response caching is ever added, exclude supplements.show or vary by user (personal panel on a public page)
Remove the leftover generated comment above the contract bind
Add a signed-in-with-match case to the opt-in real Chrome render test
Send Cache-Control: private, no-store on PDF downloads now that they can carry per-user genetics
Invert the Recommendations rule to an allow-list (Contracts, Data, Testing) so new private namespaces trip it
Use dedicated CSS classes for the genotype line and disclaimer instead of reusing grade/empty
Reaper case: stale upload whose raw file is already missing still fails cleanly
Share a throttle helper between Supplements ActionThrottle and the Genetics inline limiters
